pages.intro: Kassandra is the strongest rental market of Halkidiki. Here you find the hotels and commercial property for sale across its five municipalities, from hotels near the big beaches to shops, offices and buildings in the towns that stay open all year. Ask an adviser for the full file of each one.
pages.body:
Hotels for sale by area

Kassandra has the big beaches and the resorts of Sani, Possidi and Pefkochori, and the longest letting season: a house near the beach lets for 16 to 20 weeks a year. Sithonia has the most nature and privacy, with small coves among the pines and views of Mount Athos. On the eastern side, Aristotelis has the lowest prices per square metre, and Nea Propontida and Polygyros have long, easy beaches close to towns with a permanent population.

What each hotel listing shows

Every hotel in the list shows the facts a buyer of a business asks first: the rooms by type (single, double, triple, quadruple, suites and studios), the classification, the building area and the distance to the sea. The full file of each hotel, with its papers, comes from an adviser.

Shops, offices and buildings

In the towns that stay open all year, such as Nea Moudania, Polygyros and Kassandreia, shops, offices and buildings serve the people who live here, not only the summer visitors.

Buying a hotel or business property in Greece

Buying works like any purchase in Greece: a Greek tax number in one day, an independent lawyer, a pre-contract with a 10% deposit, the notary deed and the land registry. Count 4 to 8 weeks in total and about 6% on top of the price for taxes and fees. For a running hotel, your lawyer also checks its operating licence.

faq.q: Where are the hotels for sale in Halkidiki?
faq.a: Across the five municipalities: near the beaches of Kassandra and Sithonia, on the coast of Aristotelis and in the towns of Nea Propontida and Polygyros. The list shows the hotels for sale today.

faq.q: What does a hotel listing include?
faq.a: The rooms by type, the classification, the building area and the distance to the sea. An adviser sends you the full file of each hotel.

faq.q: Can a commercial building qualify for the Golden Visa?
faq.a: As of November 2026, a €250,000 threshold applies only to converting a commercial building into a home; other homes in Halkidiki need €400,000.
Count 4 to 8 weeks from the tax number to the land registry, and about 6% on top of the price for taxes and fees.

pages.intro: Polygyros is the administrative capital of Halkidiki, a mountain town among pine and olive groves, with the beach villages of Gerakini and Psakoudia on the gulf below. Services stay open all year and the coast is a short drive away.
pages.body:
Polygyros, the capital of Halkidiki

Polygyros is the capital of the regional unit of Halkidiki, built on the hills among pine and olive groves. The regional offices, the courts and the general hospital of Halkidiki are here, so the town keeps its services open in every season.

The coast: Gerakini and Psakoudia

Below the town, on the gulf, are the beach villages of Gerakini and Psakoudia, near the base of Sithonia. The beaches are long and easy, close to towns with life all year, and popular with families.

The villages inland

Inland are the villages of Taxiarchis, Paleochora, Agios Prodromos and Kalyves.

Living in Polygyros all year

Families who live in Halkidiki all year often choose the area around Polygyros, for its schools, shops and the shorter drive to Thessaloniki. For a home used in winter, check the heating, the insulation and the access in bad weather before you buy.

Buying property in Polygyros

Buying in Polygyros works like anywhere in Greece: a Greek tax number in one day, an independent lawyer, a pre-contract with a 10% deposit, the notary deed and the land registry. Count 4 to 8 weeks in total and about 6% on top of the price for taxes and fees.

faq.q: Is Polygyros good for a year-round home?
faq.a: It is the regional capital, with services open all year, and the beaches of Gerakini and Psakoudia are a short drive away.

faq.q: Is there a hospital in Polygyros?
faq.a: Yes, the general hospital of Halkidiki is in Polygyros, and the large hospitals of Thessaloniki are within reach.
Gerakini and Psakoudia, on the gulf below the town, near the base of Sithonia.

pages.intro: Detached houses across the municipalities of Halkidiki: sea-view houses in Kassandra and Sithonia, quieter houses near Mount Athos and family homes close to Thessaloniki in Nea Propontida. Each listing shows the facts a buyer asks first: plot size, distance to the sea and pool.
pages.body:
Detached houses by area

Most houses for sale are on the two western peninsulas. In Kassandra they are close to the big beaches and the resorts of Sani, Possidi and Pefkochori. In Sithonia they sit among the pines above small coves, often with a view of Mount Athos. In Aristotelis, on the eastern side, the same budget buys a larger house or plot, often with a sea view. Nea Propontida, 40 to 60 km from Thessaloniki airport, and Polygyros, the regional capital, suit a family home used all year.

Detached house, maisonette or apartment?

A detached house stands on its own plot, with the most space and privacy. A maisonette gives you more space and privacy than an apartment, usually at a lower price than a detached house, and an apartment is the most affordable way to own a home here.

What a detached house costs

Detached houses start at about €200,000 near Thessaloniki; sea-view houses on Kassandra and Sithonia usually start at €500,000. The prices of the houses for sale today are shown with the list below.

Letting a house near the beach

Near the beach, a house lets for 16 to 20 weeks a year in Kassandra, the strongest rental market in Halkidiki.

Buying a house from abroad

Buying from abroad is common: you need a Greek tax number and a lawyer, viewings can be in person or by video call, and the deed can be signed with a power of attorney. Count 4 to 8 weeks in total and about 6% on top of the price for taxes and fees.

faq.q: What does a detached house in Halkidiki cost?
faq.a: Detached houses start at about €200,000 near Thessaloniki; sea-view houses on Kassandra and Sithonia usually start at €500,000.

faq.q: Can a house pay for itself with rentals?
faq.a: Near the beach, houses let for 16 to 20 weeks a year in Kassandra, the strongest rental market in Halkidiki.

faq.q: Can I buy a house from abroad?
faq.a: Yes. You need a Greek tax number and a lawyer; viewings can be in person or by video call, and the deed can be signed with a power of attorney.

faq.q: Can a house qualify for the Golden Visa?
faq.a: As of November 2026, one home of at least 120 m² bought for €400,000 or more in Halkidiki can qualify, if it is not let for short stays.
